title: Oral History of Bjarne Stroustrup
summary: A two-hour Computer History Museum oral history interview with Bjarne Stroustrup, conducted by Paul McJones in 2015. It covers his youth, education at Aarhus and Cambridge, his career at Bell Labs and elsewhere, and the design and evolution of C++.
why: HN commenters cite it as a primary source for why Stroustrup created C++, including combining C and Simula and the aim of zero-cost abstractions.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Bjarne describes his goal for C++, which was abstractions with zero runtime cost
